integrity: The theorem follows from a nonbacktracking causal witness and an explicit attaining initial condition. Two independent executable tests check finite instances. No independent external audit has been conducted.
limitations: Only finite simple forests, contact threshold at least two, and at least three states; determines worst-case extinction time, not the full initial-condition distribution. Historical unindexed equivalence remains possible.
title: Sharp branching-rank extinction clocks for excitable dynamics on forests
